adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce an `EmbeddableHost` model/table with `belongs_to :category` and a non-null `category_id` column (migration `create_embeddable_hosts`, model `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`), but it does not add any database-level FK constraint or Rails-side dependent/cleanup behavior tied to category deletion. That makes orphaned `embeddable_hosts.category_id` possible if categories can be deleted elsewhere, and the UI/template accesses `host.category` while `TopicEmbed.import` passes `eh.try(:category_id)` into `PostCreator` (with `skip_validations: true`), which could allow an invalid category reference. However, the diff does not show category-deletion behavior or prove this will occur in practice, so it’s better framed as a concrete integrity/edge-case gap rather than a currently verifiable broken behavior.
